title: Anthropic to disclose new revenue numbers as AI lab financials become central to tech trade
source_used: TradingKey and azat.tv, both summarising CNBC (CNBC page blocked, HTTP 403)
key_facts: CNBC reports, via TradingKey, that Anthropic plans to disclose third-quarter financial data for the first time at a potential investor meeting on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026.
Anthropic will present the figures to a group of institutional investors, according to two unnamed people familiar with the matter.
Anthropic declined to comment on the disclosure or the timeline for a market debut.
Bloomberg previously reported that Anthropic is preparing a pre-IPO investor day event.
TradingKey: the figures could be a basis for investors judging growth rate, profitability and IPO valuation.
azat.tv, citing Reuters: a November listing is targeted, but no debut date is officially confirmed; Anthropic filed confidentially with the SEC earlier this year and has not made a formal S-1 public.
CNBC headline: AI lab financials are becoming central to the tech trade.
quote_evidence: According to CNBC, AI company Anthropic plans to disclose its third-quarter financial data for the first time at a potential investor meeting on Wednesday, October 14.

Anthropic will present the financial data to a group of institutional investors, according to two people familiar with the matter, who asked not to be identified because the information has not been made public.
Anthropic declined to comment on the upcoming disclosure or the timeline for its market debut.
why_it_matters_hint: First look at the financials of a leading AI lab before a possible listing, which investors across the AI sector are waiting for.
event_date: Meeting set for 14 Oct 2026; reported 13 Oct 2026
notes: CNBC original blocked (HTTP 403, edge error page); read TradingKey and azat.tv relays of it. azat.tv also carries unattributed claims (valuation up to $2 trillion, revenue above $100 billion this year, OpenAI revenue clarification) which are NOT used.
